Neutral.title: Neutral
Neutral.prompt: I'm experiencing a calm, balanced, and completely neutral state of mind. Recommend low-stakes, chill movies like slice-of-life, light dramas, or cozy films that maintain a steady pace without intense emotional peaks, heavy conflict, or overwhelming plot twists.

Sad.title: Sad
Sad.prompt: I'm feeling deeply sad, melancholy, or down. I want an emotionally heavy, poignant movie—a cathartic drama or a beautiful tragedy—that safely resonates with this sorrow, helps me embrace my vulnerability, and allows me to process my feelings through a good cry.

Happy.title: Happy
Happy.prompt: I'm in a radiant, joyful, and incredibly happy mood! Keep the high-energy positive vibes going by showing me ultimate feel-good movies, vibrant comedies, or heartwarming stories filled with laughter, optimistic characters, and pure comfort that will leave me smiling from ear to ear.

Angry.title: Angry
Angry.prompt: I'm feeling angry, frustrated, or full of rage, and I need a cinematic outlet to channel this intensity. Recommend high-octane action, gritty revenge thrillers, or high-stakes fast-paced movies with raw, explosive energy that match my internal fire and adrenaline.

Fearful.title: Fearful
Fearful.prompt: I'm in the mood to flirt with fear and tension. Bring on chilling horror movies, terrifying psychological thrillers, or supernatural tales full of jump scares and dread that will heighten this uneasy feeling, making my pulse race and keeping me genuinely spooked.

Anxious.title: Anxious
Anxious.prompt: I'm feeling anxious, restless, or on edge, and I want a complex, high-tension movie that lets me sit in that suspense. Suggest claustrophobic thrillers, mind-bending mysteries, or tightly wound dramas that mirror this nervous, high-alert state of mind.

Reflexive.title: Reflexive
Reflexive.prompt: I am in a deeply reflective, introspective, and philosophical mood. Recommend profound art-house films, thought-provoking sci-fi, or existential character studies that challenge my perspective, feature deep dialogue, and leave me pondering about life long after the credits roll.

Brain-dead.title: Brain-dead
Brain-dead.prompt: My brain is completely fried, exhausted, and running on empty. I need zero-effort entertainment—turn-off-your-brain comedies, lighthearted animated features, or simple, predictable popcorn movies that are comforting, easy to follow, and require absolutely no mental heavy lifting.

Creative.title: Creative
Creative.prompt: I'm feeling deeply creative, inspired, and imaginative. Recommend avant-garde films, highly stylistic cinema, unique visual masterpieces, or stories about passionate artists that break traditional storytelling rules and act as ultimate fuel for my own artistic inspiration.

Romantic.title: Romantic
Romantic.prompt: I'm feeling romantic, sentimental, and full of affection. Show me sweeping romance movies, passionate love stories, or charming romantic comedies with incredible chemistry, poetic moments, and deep emotional connections that amplify this warm, loving mood.

Broken.title: Broken
Broken.prompt: I am completely heartbroken, emotionally shattered, and grieving a loss or breakup. Suggest heavy, painful raw dramas or bittersweet films about heartbreak and coping that validate my current suffering, mirroring the exact ache in my chest right now.

Adventurous.title: Adventurous
Adventurous.prompt: I'm craving excitement, wanderlust, and exploration! Recommend epic adventure movies, sweeping fantasy quests, grand historical journeys, or survival stories that make me feel alive, spark my curiosity, and make me want to pack a bag and explore the unknown.

Nostalgic.title: Nostalgic
Nostalgic.prompt: I'm trapped in a wave of deep nostalgia, longing for simpler times. Suggest classic cinematic gems, retro masterpieces from past decades, or coming-of-age period pieces that evoke a bittersweet warmth and reconnect me with fond memories of yesteryear.

Astonished.title: Astonished
Astonished.prompt: I'm feeling a massive sense of awe, wonder, and amazement. Recommend awe-inspiring documentaries, magnificent nature films, or jaw-dropping spectacles that highlight the beauty, scale, and mysteries of the universe, keeping me locked in this breathtaking state of 'wow'.

Hot.title: Hot
Hot.prompt: I'm feeling extremely horny, naughty, and hot right now. I'm actively looking for explicit adult content, sexy scenes, naked women, and provocative erotica to turn me on completely.

MoneyMaker.title: MoneyMaker
MoneyMaker.prompt: I am feeling incredibly ambitious, power-hungry, and money-driven. Show me cutthroat corporate dramas, stories about wall street tycoons, lavish high-society biopics, or high-stakes hustle movies that showcase massive financial success, grinding, and making it big.

Motivation.title: Motivation
Motivation.prompt: I am filled with unstoppable drive, focus, and determination. Recommend deeply inspirational sports dramas, triumph-over-adversity biopics, or high-energy underdog stories that pump me up, ignite my work ethic, and push me to conquer my personal goals.

Wow.title: Wow
Wow.prompt: I want to be completely blown away! Show me absolute blockbusters, mind-bending sci-fi with incredible plot twists, or visually stunning masterpieces with epic scale and top-tier special effects that will leave me speechless and completely mesmerized.

whatsMoodflix.title: What is Moodflix?
whatsMoodflix.description: Moodflix is ​​an AI-powered app that helps you find the perfect movie for your mood. Whether you're happy, nostalgic, melancholic, or motivated, Moodflix recommends movies that align with your emotions so you can enjoy a unique and meaningful experience. And if you can't find the words to describe how you're feeling, you can also choose from a list of moods to get a personalized recommendation.

howItWorks.title: How does Moodflix work?
howItWorks.description1: Moodflix uses artificial intelligence to understand how you feel. Simply type in a short description of your mood, or choose from our list of emotions and feelings to identify the one that best reflects your current moment. With these options, Moodflix ensures that any user, no matter how they express themselves, can receive recommendations that connect with their emotions.
howItWorks.description2: Moodflix combines Google’s Gemini API and Vercel AI SDK to interpret the emotions in your text or the emotion you select, and then suggests movies based on this analysis. Plus, thanks to the integration with TMDB API, each recommendation includes the movie poster, rating, release year, and genres, creating a complete experience.

technology.title: Technology used
technology.description1: Powered by AI and Rich Data Moodflix combines the power of emotion analysis, machine learning and rich movie data to bring you truly personalized recommendations.

next.title: Next.js
next.description: Moodflix is ​​built with Next.js, a powerful React framework for building backend and frontend in a single project.

gemini.title: Google Gemini API
gemini.description: Identify and classify the emotional tone of your text or selected emotion, ensuring that each recommendation is aligned with your mood.

TMDB.title: TMDB API
TMDB.description: It allows us to enrich each recommendation with details from the movie so that you have a complete and visually appealing experience.

technology.description2: Thanks to these technologies, Moodflix is ​​not just a movie recommender, but a tool that adapts to your emotional world and presents movies to you in a unique way.

question1.question: Is Moodflix free?
question1.answer: Yes, Moodflix is completely free! Just select your mood or choose one from our list, and you're ready to find a great movie!

question2.question: Does the app store information about my mood?
question2.answer: No, Moodflix does not store any information about your emotional state. We only use your data to generate recommendations, and then it is deleted, ensuring your privacy.

question3.question: What types of movies can I expect in the recommendations?
question3.answer: Moodflix offers a wide variety of movies tailored to match your current mood. Our recommendations span across multiple genres—from feel-good comedies to intense thrillers, heartfelt dramas, and inspiring documentaries.

question4.question: How accurate are the recommendations?
question4.answer: While our recommendations are based on AI analysis and user feedback, they may not always be perfect. However, we’re continuously working to improve the accuracy and personal relevance of our suggestions.

thanks.title: Thanks for using Moodflix
thanks.description: Thank you for taking the time to explore Moodflix! Your support means a lot to me. I created this app in hopes of helping you discover movies that resonate with your emotions and enhance your viewing experience. If you have any feedback, suggestions, or just want to share your favorite movies, please feel free to reach out to me. Happy watching!
